differences.what: the round tower: the photograph's stands on the 18th Street flank about 8 m back from the front, where the 1911 sheet draws a bump in the north wall, its eaves about 12.9 m and its cone to about 18.7 m; the draft put it at the front's north-west corner under an eave about 16 m up
differences.how: T-2538: the tower stood at u 12.6 on the flank, 1.1 m proud as the sheet draws it, eaves 12.9 m, cone 5.8 m; its axis within about 20 px of the photograph's x 698, its apex within about 25 px; T-2843: carried onto K01 as a K08 tower on the 18th Street wall, axis u 12.6, r 1.45 m, its centre 0.1 m out of the wall, eaves 12.9 m, cone to about 18.8 m; its apex within about 20 px of the photograph's

differences.what: the main block's height: two storeys of wall to a heavy cornice at about 8.1 m (principal floor 1.45 m up a stair of nine risers), the third storey in the roof; the draft stood three full storeys to an eave at about 12 m
differences.how: T-2538: principal floor 1.45 m, storeys 3.55 and 3.1 m to the cornice at 8.1 m; T-2843: K01's principal floor 1.45 m and storeys 3.55 and 3.1 m, the cornice line within about 10 px of the photograph's along the front

differences.what: the roof: very steep slate faces rising from the cornice to a flat deck ringed with cresting at about 16-19 m; the draft had a hip about 56 degrees off a 12 m eave
differences.how: T-2538: the builder's 72-degree mansard with a 7.2 m lower face and a low deck, its deck line within about 25 px of the photograph's; T-2843: a K05 mansard whose straight 72-degree faces hold two storeys (lower rise 7.2 m), a low tin deck over them; its faces within about 15 px of the photograph's and its peak about 1 m over the deck's line

differences.what: the south pavilion: three storeys of wall at the south end of the front under a steep coped stone gable, its apex about 17 m
differences.how: T-2538: part p_south, three storeys to 13.9 m under a 58-degree gable facing the avenue; its gable within about 30 px of the photograph's; T-2843: a K08 projection flush with the south corner, three storeys to 13.9 m with paired lights, its face within about 15 px of the photograph's x 1235-1345 (its gable is open below)

differences.what: the 18th Street flank: a three-storey section east of the tower and a gabled section beyond it, then a lower two-storey east range; the draft ran the whole flank at one height
differences.how: T-2538: parts p_flank and r3 at three storeys, r2 at two, eaves 13.9 and 8.1 m; T-2843: the section on a K08 projection to 13.9 m (6.0 m wide, against the tower), the gabled section and the east range as slated K01 wings at three and two storeys

differences.what: the east turret: a small round turret under a cone at the flank's north-east corner, its eaves about 8 m and its apex about 12.7 m; the draft had none
differences.how: T-2842 could not carry it (a K08 tower on a wing's wall stands 1.0 m past the wing's eave); T-2900: built as a K08 corner turret on the east range's 18th Street wall, its ring flush with the range's rear wall, 2.8 m across with its centre 0.3 m inside the wall (so 1.1 m proud), its eaves the range's own 8.1 m and its slate cone whole over the range's roof to about 12.7 m with a finial; its eaves line within about 5 px of the print's (y 892-895), its cone's flare within about 5-10 px at both edges (x 175-250 on the print, 170-245 in the render)

differences.what: the corner entrance: an open loggia at the front's north-west corner, one round arch on each face, and a broad stair of about nine risers between curved cheek walls coming down the front; the build has a flat door and a straight stoop
differences.how: T-2910: a loggia behind two round arches, one on each face, each 1.9 m across centred 1.6 m from the corner and crowned 3.6 m (2.15 m over the 1.45 m floor) under a voussoir ring and keystone, within about 10 px of the photograph's arches; the room behind them with its double door in the back wall, seen through the 18th Street arch where the photograph shows the door frame; the stone balcony corbelled under the 18th Street arch; nine risers of 0.161 m coming down the front out of the front arch, 2.3 m broad, between cheeks that run level by the arch and sweep down to blocks at the foot, the foot within about 15 px of the photograph's

differences.what: the loggia's carving: the archivolts' mouldings, the carved piers and panels beside and over both arches, the carved blocks at the cheeks' foot and the balcony's carved face; the build lays them in plain stone under a voussoir ring
differences.how: T-2923: each arch's archivolt in two faces (0.07 and 0.11 m, 0.035 and 0.07 m proud) round its head and down both jambs, the keystone gone as the print has none; a carved pier each side, 0.30 m broad 0.22 m outside the intrados, on a base and under a capital at 3.75-3.92 m, a chain of lozenges down its shaft; a rosette in each spandrel; a round-headed tablet on each foot block's front and two on its outer face; the balcony's face in four raised panels with a lozenge each. The front's corner pier within about 5 px of the print's (x 1000-1012 against 995-1007) and its capitals at the print's height within about 10 px; the shafts' carving, the capitals' (plain blocks here) and the blocks' tracery are reconstructed (L-kimball-1801-loggia-carving-2923)

differences.what: both loggia arches, and their carving with them, render about 15-20 px south (the front's, x 1025-1105 against the print's 1010-1080) and east (the 18th Street face's, its corner pier at x 980-995 against the print's 955-974) of the print's
differences.how: T-1890 (seen by T-2923; the arches' places are T-2910's)

differences.what: the carved frieze over the principal storey over the loggia; the build lays it in plain stone
differences.how: T-2932: over each arch from capital to capital, the relief frieze from 3.92 to 4.49 m under a moulded course to 4.67 m, its rendered band within about 10 px of the print's (y 815-850 against 822-857), carved with T-2819's guilloche for the print's leafage; and the cartouche band from the course to 5.40 m under the sill (y 767-810 against the print's 767-815), an oval cartouche on the arch's axis and a roundel each side for the print's scrolled frames; the carving's forms are reconstructed (L-kimball-1801-loggia-frieze-2932)

differences.what: the front's carved pilasters and moulded window surrounds: a carved pilaster a storey at the bow's north junction and at each corner of the pavilion's face, each under a capital below the band over it with a chain of carved lozenges down its shaft, the principal storey's on a corbel under the sill course; every light of the bow and pair of the pavilion in a moulded frame under a projecting head; the build laid them in plain stone
differences.how: T-2931: K08 pilasters at the bow's ends (0.22 m, 0.07 m proud) and the pavilion face's corners (0.30 m, 0.08 m proud), one a storey on a base and under a capital, a chain of lozenges on each shaft, the lowest from the 1.75 m sill line on a two-step corbel; K08 surrounds round the bow's lights (0.12 m jambs) and the pavilion's pairs (0.20 m) in two steps under a hood. The bow's north pilaster within about 5 px of the print's (x 1127-1137); the capitals and corbels at the print's heights within about 20 px. The capitals are plain blocks where the print's are carved, and the pavilion's two stand as far south as its face does (the next difference)

differences.what: the south pavilion's face renders about 30 px south of the print's at its north corner (the print's pilaster at x 1232-1250, the build's face from about x 1265) and about 55 px at its south corner (x 1340 against about 1395), its pairs of lights and its pilasters with it
differences.how: T-2540 (the envelope's match records); seen while T-2931 read the pilasters on the pavilion's corners

differences.what: the bow balcony's pierced panels: the print's balustrade on the bow is pierced in a diagonal lattice of diamonds between posts, one post showing a quarter of the way round from the north wall; the build had square stone balusters
differences.how: T-2930: K08's stone balustrade with four pierced panels between five posts, each a diagonal lattice of 0.05 m straps crossing at 0.16 m in two staggered rows of diamonds, on a 0.10 m base course under a 0.13 m coping; the seen post within about 5 px of the print's (x 1191 against 1186-1190), about five diamonds across a panel as the print shows, the coping within about 10 px of the print's. The balustrade runs on past the print's pilaster at x 1231 to x 1270, where the pavilion's carved pilaster (T-2931) is not built to hide it

differences.what: the bowed bay in the middle of the front, two storeys under a balcony, and the front's openings: paired and mullioned windows; the build has the draft's evenly spaced sash. The sheet's bulge (v 4.8-10.2) and the photograph's bay (about 60 px further north) disagree about where it stands
differences.how: T-2921: a K08 bow 3.4 m on its chord centred at v 5.05 and 0.8 m out, where the photograph has it (its outline within about 5 px of the print's at the north junction, x 1130, and at the pavilion's pilaster, x 1245); one transomed light a storey, 1.5 m clear, turned 20 degrees toward 18th Street so each fills the face the print shows (x 1153-1230 against the render's 1155-1225), the principal storey's 2.4 m from 1.75 m and the second's 2.15 m from 5.4 m, their heads within about 5 px; the bow carried to 8.7 m under K10's moulded stone cornice, which the print wraps round it over a frieze, and a 0.6 m stone balustrade on it, its coping within about 8 px of the print's; the pavilion's windows one mullioned and transomed pair a storey, 2.0 m clear, centred on its face, their heads within about 10 px

differences.what: all-stone walls: Bedford stone laid in courses on the front and the flank alike, with string courses and the corbel table; the build is the draft's flat stand-in stone
differences.how: T-2843: an all-stone K01 house in K02's Bedford stone, coursed round every face; the string courses and the corbel table stay open under T-2790 and T-2540

differences.what: the tower's form: a shaft about 2.4 m across under a corbelled upper stage about 3.6 m across, its cone flaring from the stage; the build is one eight-sided prism 2.9 m across

the roof's dormers and deck: tall hooded dormers in the steep faces, the iron cresting and finials round the deck, the pavilion's and flank's tall stacks; the build's dormers sit sunk in the face and show only their gables, and it has no cresting
the gabled section on the flank: a gable facing 18th Street with a balcony at about 11.5 m; the build has a hip there
the south and east sides and the rear
differences.how: the camera looks from the north-west; T-2540 reads the HABS photographs for them

differences.what: colour: the stone's tone and the slate's
differences.how: a monochrome print

differences.what: the south pavilion's coped stone gable over its third storey, its apex about 17 m with a carved panel and finial; the build caps the pavilion with K08's low hip at its 13.9 m wall top, where the draft had a steep gable
the main cornice: a heavy moulded stone cornice under the roof's faces; the build's eave is K05's plain fascia and soffit (K10's moulded stone cornice stands only under a flat or gable roof)

the pavilion and the flank section stand about 0-0.4 m proud on the sheet; the build stands both 0.6 m proud (K08's pavilion depth, the least its window recesses fit in), and the main eave dies behind their faces, and the flank section is 6.0 m wide (K08's widest) against the photograph's about 7.8 m, short of the gabled section
differences.how: L-kimball-1801-k01-2843; T-2540 reads the flank's sections

differences.what: the east range runs on south behind the gabled section to v 18.3 on the sheet; the build stops it at the gabled section's 6 m (a K01 wing stands inside its host wall); not seen from this camera
differences.how: T-2900: built whole, a K01 wing longer than its host wall, from the 18th Street wall to v 18.3 under one hip, its front wall drawn where it runs past the gabled section; the photograph does not show it

differences.what: the east turret's shaft and finial: the print shows the shaft about 15 px wider toward the front (to x 237; the build's to about x 220), a moulded band at its first floor and a heavy eave moulding, and a finial spike about 40 px taller than the build's
